image_description: A silver-colored, metallic breastplate armor piece displayed against a white background. The armor features a stylized female torso shape with distinct breast cups and a central ridge. It has red leather-like straps or lining visible at the shoulders, sides, and waist. The surface is highly reflective with specular highlights indicating a polished metal texture.
